title: Crocin facilitates peripheral nerve regeneration through modulation of the STAT3/Bcl-2/Beclin-1 signaling axis-mediated autophagic pathway.
authors: Tian, Dongbo; Bo, Yixin; Ying, Jiahao; Deng, Dun; Zhang, Jialuo; Lu, Shuchang; Xie, Jingfei; Hong, Zipu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究藏红花素通过STAT3/Bcl-2/Beclin-1信号轴调节自噬促进周围神经再生，仅涉及STAT3蛋白的分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Peripheral nerve injury (PNI) is notoriously difficult to repair due to impaired axonal regeneration and dysregulated inflammatory microenvironments. This study demonstrates that crocin facilitates peripheral nerve regeneration by modulating the STAT3/Bcl-2/Beclin-1 signaling axis, enhancing autophagy while suppressing NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis. In a rat model of sciatic nerve crush injury, crocin treatment improved axonal regrowth and ultrastructural remyelination, as evidenced by upregulated expression of beta3-Tubulin, neurofilament-200 (NF200), and myelin basic protein (MBP), alongside significantly elevated sciatic functional index (SFI) scores, reduced muscle atrophy, and diminished collagen deposition. Mechanistically, crocin attenuated mitochondrial dysfunction by reducing mitochondrial ROS (mtROS) and restoring membrane potential (DeltaPsim), thereby inhibiting NLRP3/GSDMD-dependent pyroptosis. Molecular docking identified STAT3 as a pivotal target, while Western blot and immunofluorescence confirmed marked downregulation of pyroptosis-related proteins (NLRP3, GSDMD, and IL-1beta). To our knowledge, this is the first study to elucidate crocin's dual role in orchestrating autophagy-pyroptosis crosstalk to accelerate nerve repair, offering a multi-target natural compound-based strategy for PNI therapy.
abstract_zh: 周围神经损伤（PNI）因轴突再生受损及炎症微环境失调而难以修复。本研究证明，藏红花素通过调节STAT3/Bcl-2/Beclin-1信号轴，增强自噬并抑制NLRP3炎症小体介导的焦亡，从而促进周围神经再生。在大鼠坐骨神经挤压损伤模型中，藏红花素治疗改善了轴突再生长和超微结构髓鞘再生，表现为beta3-Tubulin、神经丝蛋白-200（NF200）和髓鞘碱性蛋白（MBP）表达上调，同时坐骨神经功能指数（SFI）评分显著升高，肌肉萎缩减轻，胶原沉积减少。机制上，藏红花素通过减少线粒体活性氧（mtROS）并恢复膜电位（DeltaPsim）来减轻线粒体功能障碍，从而抑制NLRP3/GSDMD依赖性焦亡。分子对接确定STAT3为关键靶点，而Western blot和免疫荧光证实焦亡相关蛋白（NLRP3、GSDMD和IL-1beta）显著下调。据我们所知，这是首次阐明藏红花素在协调自噬-焦亡串扰以加速神经修复中的双重作用，为PNI治疗提供了一种基于多靶点天然化合物的策略。
